question: In the year 1952, who among the following lent his voice for the film 'Amar Bhupali', which was being produced in two languages simultaneously and he sang in both Bengali and Marathi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manna Dey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the year 1952, **Manna Dey** lent his voice for the film **'Amar Bhupali'**.
 
• He is renowned for his versatile singing in various Indian languages, and for this film, he sang in both **Bengali** and **Marathi**, as it was produced in two languages simultaneously.
 
• Manna Dey had an incredibly diverse repertoire that included classical, semi-classical, folk, and contemporary songs
 
• Throughout his career, Manna Dey collaborated with some of the greatest music composers in Indian cinema,
 
 
• such as **S.D. Burman**, **R.D. Burman**, and **Salil Chowdhury**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Kishore Kumar**

 
 
• Kishore Kumar was not only **a legendary playback singer** but also an actor, director, and producer in Indian cinema.
 
• His ability to sing in various genres, from romantic to sad to comic songs, made him a unique figure in Bollywood.
 
• **He is known for his distinctive voice and expressive singing style. Hits like "Mere Sapno Ki Rani," "Ek Ladki Bheegi Bhaagi Si," and "Khaike Paan Banaras Wala**" are some of his timeless classics that showcase his versatility and creativity.
 
 
 
• ** Hemanta Mukherjee**
 
 
• Hemanta Mukherjee was a **prominent playback singer **in Indian cinema, especially known for his work in Bengali films.
 
• His** contributions to Hindi music were also significant, with many memorable songs in the 1950s and 60s.**
 
• His rich and soulful voice earned him a place among the greats.
 
• Songs like **"Tumi Robe Nirobe" and "Bajlo Tomar Alor Benu"** highlight his mastery in conveying deep emotions through music.
 
 
 
• ** Debabrata Biswas**
 
 
• **Folk and Ghazal Singer**: Debabrata Biswas was celebrated for his renditions of Bengali folk songs and ghazals.
 
• He was **known for preserving traditional music while also introducing innovative elements.**
 
• He contributed significantly to Bengali culture and music through his performances and recordings, promoting folk traditions and winning the hearts of many with his emotive singing style.
